slo_title: Students will be able to understand and explain the human being as a co-existence of the Self (consciousness) and the Body (material entity)

options.B: Respect, trust, right understanding, and knowledge

mcq.answer_text: Respect, trust, right understanding, and knowledge

mcq.q: Which of the following reflects the harmony of self and body?

options.B: Right understanding in self, leading to proper care of the body
options.C: Ignoring physical needs for long hours

mcq.answer_text: Right understanding in self, leading to proper care of the body

mcq.q: Why is the self considered primary in coexistence?

options.A: Because it guides the body through desires, thoughts, and decisions
options.D: Because it generates energy for muscles

mcq.answer_text: Because it guides the body through desires, thoughts, and decisions

mcq.q: For holistic human development, it is essential to:

options.C: Ensure harmony between self and body
options.D: Ignore both and rely on technology

mcq.answer_text: Ensure harmony between self and body

mcq.q: What happens if we take care of the body but ignore the self?

options.B: Physical health improves but conflicts, dissatisfaction, and stress remain
options.D: Self and body remain balanced automatically

mcq.answer_text: Physical health improves but conflicts, dissatisfaction, and stress remain

sq.q: Why is understanding the co-existence of self and body important for engineering students?
answer: Understanding this helps engineering students appreciate human-centered design, ergonomics, AI-human interactions, and ethical considerations in technology, as it emphasizes both physical and conscious aspects of humans.

sq.q: Give an example of how the self and body work together in daily life.
answer: While driving a car, the body performs physical actions like steering and braking, while the self makes decisions, observes surroundings, and plans routes. Both must function together for safe driving.

lq.q: Explain the meaning of harmony in society.
answer: Society is the next larger order after family. It is made up of many families living together and making collective effort for a common goal. Harmony in society means that human beings live together in a way that fulfils the human goal. The human goal includes right understanding and right feeling in every individual, prosperity in every family, fearlessness or trust in society, and co-existence with nature. For this, society requires proper systems such as education-sanskar, health-sanyam, production-work, justice-suraksha and exchange-storage. When these systems are guided by right understanding, they support mutual happiness and mutual prosperity. Thus, a harmonious society is not just a crowd of people; it is a family-based society where individuals and families participate responsibly for the fulfilment of the human goal.
